hooks.command: file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$file" ] && echo "$file" | grep -qE '\.(tsx|ts)$'; then if grep -q ' — ' "$file" 2>/dev/null; then echo "ERROR: em dash found in $file, remove it before continuing"; exit 1; fi; fi
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20; exit ${PIPESTATUS[0]}
osascript -e 'display notification "Claude Code is done" with title "dustinedwards.info"' 2>/dev/null || notify-send 'dustinedwards.info' 'Claude Code is done' 2>/dev/null || true
